title: LER Specialist
description:
**Description**
Amazon is searching for a smart and motivated individual to serve as a specialist on its Law Enforcement Response (LER) team for India. The LER team consists of a dedicated group of specialists who are responsible for responding to law enforcement requests (e.g., subpoenas, search warrants) received from government agencies. Amazon is seeking a talented individual who can contribute to this critical function as the company continues to grow around the world.
  
  
Each LER specialist's principal duty is to make sure that requests are processed professionally and expeditiously, all while ensuring the privacy and security of business and customer information in accordance with the law and with Amazon's policies and procedures. This requires great judgment and experience dealing with challenging and ambiguous situations.
  
  
Candidates must be self-motivated, have a strong work ethic, and be able to work independently and at times with little supervision.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Evaluate and respond to law enforcement requests in a manner consistent with the privacy and security of business and customer information, in accordance with the law and with Amazon's policies and procedures
* Ability to periodically (on a set rotation) receive and process emergency law enforcement requests both during and outside of normal business hours, and sometimes overnight
* Utilize a combination of web-based applications and data extraction tools to compile information potentially responsive to a particular law enforcement request
* Communicate verbally and in writing with law enforcement personnel, Amazon employees, outside counsel, and others
* Assist in the identification of patterns and trends that might be evident from the processing of certain law enforcement requests
* Handle the most complex and challenging law enforcement requests, as well as special projects
* Help lead the training and development of other LER specialists
* Travel periodically, including on short notice, to represent Amazon in courts and law enforcement offices, as required.
* Sign and issue certificates/letters to authenticate digital evidence in response to law enforcement requests

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience working in fast paced environments, and managing workload even during times of stress, or escalated activity
* Experience in business development and building strong client relationship
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and judgment
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with colleagues
* Excellent organizational skills, and ability to work independently and manage multiple projects at once
* Ability to demonstrate sound judgment even in ambiguous situations

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience responding to requests from law enforcement agencies
* Experience in making and/or responding to law enforcement requests
* Experience with computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Written and/or verbal proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Hindi

title: National Security Officer
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft's National Security charter for India strengthens national cyber resilience, elevates customer readiness, ensures regulatory compliance and positions Microsoft as the trusted security partner to governments and critical industries. The charter runs on four pillars: Keeping the Nation Safe (cyber agencies, Project ATLAS, Sovereign Cloud); Keeping Customers Safe (incident readiness and compliance); Keeping Citizens Safe (CrimeOS, law enforcement and anti-fraud); and Keeping Microsoft Safe (MeitY empanelment, DPDPA and CERT-In compliance).
  
  
The Deputy National Security Officer owns the day-to-day operations of this charter, so that the National Security Officer can focus on executive and regulator engagement and on Solution Engineering leadership. The role sits at the intersection of national cyber agencies, regulators, Public Sector customers and Microsoft's global security organizations.
  
  
A recent example of the work: Microsoft's One-Microsoft response with the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C, Ministry of Home Affairs) on the transnational "Boss Scam" CEO-impersonation malware campaign, coordinating Defender Security Research, the Digital Crimes Unit (DCU), the Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) and CELA.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Agency and regulator cadence. Run the monthly engagement cadence with 8+ national cyber agencies and regulators (CERT-In, NCSC, NCIIPC, I4C, RBI, MeitY, SEBI, IRDAI); prepare briefings, track commitments and coordinate MSTIC quarterly threat briefings to top agencies.
* Threat-intelligence and incident coordination. Serve as the operational point of contact for government-origin threat intelligence and malware submissions; route and track cases across Defender Security Research, MSRC, DCU, CDOC and CELA; run the intake/case register and standardized status reporting to agencies; coordinate CERT-In regulatory incident notifications with CELA.
* Government Security Program (GSP). Drive onboarding of Cybersecurity agencies.
* Cybersecurity Boardroom programme. Deliver 12 executive Cybersecurity Boardrooms per year for PS-critical customers with CDOC, MSTIC and advisory partners (EY, PwC); drive WARA/WASA and Unified Security coverage of PS-critical customers with CSU.
* Compliance and regulatory point of view. Support MeitY Advanced Services Empanelment, the DPDPA readiness assessment and the India Regulatory PoV (CERT-In, RBI, DPDPA, SEBI); map Microsoft cloud capabilities to Indian regulatory requirements with CELA.
* Skilling at scale. Run the Government CISO programme and national awareness programmes (targets: 100K Level-1 awareness, 1,000 professionals, 500 Government CISOs via NEILIT/NeGD MoUs; 50+ agency deep-dives).
* Citizen safety. Support CrimeOS deployment at I4C and state law-enforcement agencies, law-enforcement request handling with CELA/LENS/DCU, and containment of consumer-platform abuse (for example, Digital Arrest scams).
* Sovereign and national programmes. Support Project ATLAS, the Secure Windows for Government baseline with CERT-In, and Microsoft Cloud for Sovereignty / Azure Local positioning with agencies.
* Thought leadership. Contribute to 24+ articles and talks per year; represent Microsoft Security at agency forums and CISO communities; brief agency leadership and CISOs independently.
* Field support. Support account and security specialist teams on regulation-driven customer requirements in Public Sector and regulated industries.

Success measures (first 12 months)
  
  

* 8+ agencies and regulators on a formal monthly engagement cadence.
* Oboarded agencies to the Government Security Program.
* Standardized intake and status-reporting process live for government threat submissions.
* 12 Cybersecurity Boardrooms delivered for PS-critical customers.
* MeitY Advanced Empanelment complete and the India Regulatory PoV published.
* Government CISO programme launched and skilling targets on track.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in cybersecurity with depth in threat intelligence, incident response or security operations.
* Hands-on fluency with the Microsoft Security stack: Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender (XDR, Endpoint, Office 365), Security Copilot and Purview.
* Experience working with or inside government, law-enforcement, CERT or regulatory bodies in India.
* Proven ability to brief senior government officials and CISOs without support.
* Strong programme-management and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; Hindi is an advantage.
* Indian citizen or eligible to work in India [To be confirmed with HR / CELA for any clearance considerations].

**Preferred**

* Prior NSO/NTO, CISO, CERT or national-agency experience.
* Malware analysis or threat-hunting background.
* Knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape: CERT-In directions, MeitY cloud empanelment, DPDPA, and RBI/SEBI/IRDAI cyber frameworks.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, SC-200 or SC-100.
* Experience with sovereign cloud or air-gapped deployments.
* Public speaking and published thought leadership.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

The role of technology in legal functions is growing exponentially and allowing legal departments to transform how they improve their processes, increase efficiencies and transform the future of legal services delivery. Configure contract management technologies based on requirements documented by the TMC client facing team.

Multiple successful project implementation experience in, Sirion or Icertis or other CLM applications.

MBA or Chartered Accountant with overall experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation and Audit

title: Associate - Personal Independence Compliance Testing
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Associate \- Independence \- Risk Management Services**
 This role requires the candidate to provide testing support to regions and execute global Independence processes in alignment with EY Global (EYG) policies. These processes are designed to safeguard EY's independence by performing testing procedures on EY professionals to ensure adherence to the firm's personal independence policies. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring professionals’ financial relationships to identify and report potential conflicts of interest with audit clients. Furthermore, the role involves interpreting GDS policies, performing compliance checks and audits, determining required actions, and providing recommendations based on firm guidance.
   

  

**The** 
**opportunity**
 Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Center of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.
   

  

 This opportunity will be part of the largest sub\-service function, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting EY professionals to maintain auditor objectivity by identifying and reporting any potential conflicts of interest that could compromise an auditor's independence. This includes assessing employee financial and personal relationships, conducting investigations, providing guidance on resolving personal independence matters, and testing for findings or issues related to the financial holdings of EY professionals.
   

  

 RMS Independence team is currently 950\+ people strong, operating from 3 locations and 5 centers’: India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in development and operating of key Independence processes.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to contribute to EY's reputation as an independent auditor by supporting niche Independence profiles within a dynamic and growing environment. You'll work closely with EY professionals to identify and assess their personal independence\-related risks. This will involve collaborating with senior team members and stakeholders to resolve queries and gather information, ultimately positioning you as a subject matter expert in Independence processes.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 An Associate within the GDS RMS Independence PICT team, will be responsible for developing a working knowledge of Personal Independence concepts, including financial interests, family relations, and business relationships. You will execute procedures as outlined in the EYG Independence policies, conduct research, and make updates to various EY tools and databases used to monitor family and financial relationships (like securities, loans, insurance policies, etc). Through these activities, you will contribute to helping EY Professionals identify independence\-related risks, while analyzing their financial holdings and relationships to determine if they and EY are independent under the relevant rules.
   

  

**Technical expertise**
* Possess a solid understanding of financial products, such as equities, structured products, and mutual funds, while executing work requests and projects from initiation to completion according to established procedures.
* Conduct research and analysis on EY professionals' financial interests and family relationships, including brokerage accounts, loans, and insurance policies, to assess the permissibility of their investments.
* Participate in wide range of projects and collaborate with project managers for timely completion of assigned work.
* Deliver comprehensive testing support to regions and carrying out global Independence compliance processes in accordance with EY Global policies \& local regional requirements.
* Take part in team discussions/activities, service functions/organization wide initiatives.
* Research and gather required information from various external and internal sources.
* Understand and strive to meet and exceed the defined individual KPIs for the role.
* Build working knowledge of different internal Independence tools under team’s purview
* Develop technical expertise of personal independence processes to assume subject matter expert responsibilities.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Possess strong communication and inter\-personal skills.
* Foster a diverse and inclusive team environment by actively participating in team events and engagements.
* Must possess a client\- centric and enablement mindset.
* Demonstrate professionalism, industry competence, and clear communication when engaging with onshore teams.
* Prioritize tasks and manage time efficiently to meet business expectations while maintaining quality and adhering to deadlines.
* Consistently uphold the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and core values.
* Ability to handle sensitive information confidentially and work effectively around confidential information.
* Demonstrate adaptability and agility in dynamic situations, effectively facilitating change management.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Masters/post\-graduate degree (preferably in Finance) from a reputed institute.
* 1 – 3 years of experience in research and analysis in a professional services firm
* Well\-developed analytical, interpersonal, and communication (both verbal and written) skills in English
* Basic understanding of financial products like equities, mutual funds, pension plans, insurance policies etc


**Technologies and Tools**
* Experience in MS office suites like Outlook, MS excel, Word, SharePoint etc


**What You Can Look For**
* A team of people with technical experience, business acumen and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment.
* A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY’s brand name.
* A team that runs on foundational values of trust, respect, integrity and teaming.
* A team that functions with One\-Team mindset and values diversity and inclusiveness.
* Opportunities to work with Global teams and stakeholders
* A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiencies to processes.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Responsible AI Manager
description:
**Responsible AI Manager** 




  





**Location** 
 : Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience** 
 : 8\-12 years of relevant experience
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm known for entrepreneurial, action\-oriented professionals who take a hands\-on approach to solving complex client problems and delivering measurable results. The firm’s culture values independent thinkers and doers, guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. In 2023, A\&M established a high\-quality Global Capability Center in India to support end\-to\-end case delivery, thought leadership, specialized talent, automation, and faster collaboration across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The 900\+ member GCC works with business units across Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources, and Financial Services. Unlike a traditional back\-office model, the center partners directly with global case teams to create client and business impact. The role joins the newly formed Global AI \& Knowledge Organization, led by the Chief AI \& Knowledge Officer, alongside product and technology, change management, knowledge management, operations, value, and governance teams.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Responsible AI Manager will help build and operationalize Alvarez \& Marsal’s global responsible AI capability from the ground up. The role owns the governance mechanisms that determine how AI is assessed, approved, deployed, monitored, and retired across internal, vendor, and client\-facing use cases. You will combine technical depth in data, AI/ML systems, architecture, security, and lifecycle controls with strong governance judgment. Working with GAIKO, IT, Risk, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and the AI Operating Committee, you will establish practical standards that protect confidentiality, privacy, fairness, security, and client trust without slowing responsible innovation. Success means creating a repeatable operating model, improving decision quality, making risk visible to senior leaders, and embedding responsible AI into delivery and adoption practices across geographies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the global Responsible AI framework, including policies, standards, intake, use\-case approval, risk escalation, and operating interfaces with existing technology risk review forums.
* Define lifecycle controls for AI development and deployment, covering sandbox environments, data permissions, architecture reviews, promotion gates, approval forums, client\-facing use, and decommissioning.
* Lead technical and responsible AI assessments of vendor tools, partnerships, internally built systems, agentic workflows, and engagement\-team prototypes, challenging evidence on data handling, residency, security, bias, and confidentiality.
* Establish pre\-deployment ethics reviews covering impact assessments, fairness testing, documentation, transparency, accuracy, escalation paths, and sign\-off criteria for models and tools.
* Build the global AI risk taxonomy, register, monitoring, and audit mechanisms, tracking model drift, performance degradation, data\-control violations, regulatory gaps, and lifecycle accountability.
* Create client AI review processes, delivery playbooks, employee guidelines, and adoption materials that embed responsible AI into project lifecycles and make compliant use practical across practices and regions.
* Prepare executive reporting on AI risk posture, decisions, exceptions, and remediation for the AI Operating Committee, AI Board, and client audiences when required.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* 8–12 years of experience with at least 2 years in AI governance, responsible AI, technology risk, data governance, security/GRC engineering, ML engineering, data engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to build governance frameworks, risk programs, compliance functions, policies, standards, controls, and operating models, preferably while standing up a new function or practice.
* Hands\-on understanding of data flows, data architecture, data pipelines, model lifecycles, API and integration architecture, agentic patterns, MCP\-style integrations, cloud residency, and security controls.
* Strong working knowledge of EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, GDPR, India’s DPDP Act, and related global privacy, security, and AI requirements.
* Experience conducting security assessments, controls reviews, governance compliance activities, third\-party/vendor assessments, and risk evaluations with the ability to challenge technical claims.
* Ability to communicate complex technical and governance issues clearly to practitioners, business stakeholders, executive committees, C\-suite leaders, and client audiences.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and drive implementation across matrixed, fast\-paced, geographically distributed professional services environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Consulting or professional services experience in an internal responsible AI function or client advisory role covering AI strategy, risk, compliance, or technology governance.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI and LLM platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable tools, including confidentiality, residency, and data\-handling considerations.
* Certifications such as GRCP, CIPP, CRISC, IEEE CertifAIEd, Trustworthy AI, or another relevant responsible AI, privacy, security, or risk credential.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring technical credibility across AI/ML systems, data governance, architecture, security controls, and lifecycle management, enabling you to assess how systems actually work rather than reviewing policy in isolation.
* You bring governance\-building experience, with the judgment to convert regulatory expectations and risk principles into practical standards, decision rights, control points, and operating routines.
* You bring balanced stakeholder leadership, partnering effectively with engineers, data teams, Information Security, Legal, Risk, Compliance, delivery leaders, and executives while maintaining independent challenge.
* You bring an implementation mindset suited to a newly formed, high\-urgency global organization: you can create structure from ambiguity, prioritize material risks, influence without authority, and deliver usable tools that improve adoption and client trust.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Shape a global responsible AI function at an early stage, defining its charter, roadmap, operating model, controls, and influence across a rapidly growing consulting organization.
* Work alongside senior leaders and global practitioners on AI transformation that directly affects client delivery, firm risk, technology choices, and the future of professional services.
* Grow in an entrepreneurial culture that rewards impact, continuous learning, independent thinking, collaboration, and meaningful contributions to complex business outcomes.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A high\-impact opportunity within A\&M’s newly formed Global AI \& Knowledge Organization, with exposure to global leadership, emerging AI use cases, and enterprise\-level governance decisions.
* A culture of meritocracy with structured performance development, technical training, formal learning, and on\-the\-job opportunities to expand your expertise and career trajectory.
* Benefits and well\-being resources designed to support your professional growth and personal journey, alongside a collaborative and inclusive working environment.

**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm built around entrepreneurial, action\-oriented professionals who solve complex client problems and deliver measurable results. The firm values Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, creating a collaborative environment for independent thinkers and doers. A\&M Global Capability Center Private Limited, established in India in 2023, partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across business units and geographies. The center supports end\-to\-end client delivery and thought leadership rather than traditional back\-office work. Its teams serve the Americas, EMEA, and APAC across industries including Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The rapidly growing GCC is already a 1,000\+ member team. It combines consulting and industry expertise with specialized talent, automation, and hybrid delivery models to improve speed, scale, quality, and client value.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Conflicts \& Intake Analyst owns the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of legal conflict checks and business\-intake records for new clients, matters, and existing engagements. The role uses conflicts databases, Boolean search techniques, structured review, and stakeholder follow\-up to identify related parties, clarify discrepancies, and support ethical risk decisions. Reporting to the Team Manager, you will work with attorneys and business representatives to vet incoming requests, update matter records, and prepare clear reports for review and approval. Your work will protect the firm from conflicts of interest, improve intake quality, and enable teams to pursue new business with confidence. This onsite Gurgaon role requires sound judgment, strong organization, and flexibility for scheduled after\-hours, weekend, and rotational on\-call coverage when business demands require it.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Run timely and accurate conflict searches for preliminary checks, formally submitted new business, new clients, and matters, using database research and Boolean techniques to surface relevant relationships.
* Own daily matter updates by adding new parties, maintaining conflict memos, and ensuring approved client and engagement information remains complete, current, and traceable.
* Vet all requests entering the department, including matter reopenings, new business for existing or new clients, and preliminary checks, resolving missing or inconsistent information before review.
* Evaluate search results and discrepancies methodically, then consolidate findings into clear reports that help attorneys and business stakeholders assess conflicts and manage ethical risk.
* Liaise confidently with attorneys and business representatives by email, telephone, and in person to obtain, clarify, and validate information needed for client and matter intake.
* Prioritize urgent and competing requests in a time\-sensitive environment, maintaining quality, responsiveness, and follow\-through without compromising accuracy or compliance requirements.
* Support the integrity of the conflicts database by applying consistent data standards, documenting updates, and entering general client information after new business approval.
* Participate in scheduled after\-hours or weekend projects and rotational remote on\-call shifts to maintain dependable conflicts support across global teams and deadlines.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Hands\-on experience conducting legal conflict searches, business intake, and conflicts database reviews, with strong attention to detail, accuracy, documentation quality, and ethical risk awareness.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the confidence to engage attorneys and business stakeholders at different levels with clarity, professionalism, and customer\-service orientation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word, plus practical ability to use Boolean search operators and techniques for structured information retrieval.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Prior experience in a law firm, legal department, or professional\-services environment where confidentiality, compliance, and rapid response were essential to daily operations.
* Direct experience with conflicts checking, related\-party research, engagement databases, matter management, or legal business\-intake workflows will help you contribute quickly.
* Familiarity with ABA mandates, conflicts\-of\-interest controls, and ethical risk management is advantageous for evaluating search results and escalating potential concerns appropriately.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Four to six years of experience, including at least three years in a legal, law\-firm, or legal department environment, with conflicts checking or legal intake exposure preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, urgent requests, follow\-ups, and time\-sensitive deadlines while preserving thoroughness, quality, and data integrity.
* A methodical problem\-solving approach that helps you investigate discrepancies, distinguish relevant relationships, and escalate issues with practical recommendations and complete supporting information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, enabling confident interaction with attorneys, business representatives, and colleagues through email, telephone, and in\-person collaboration.
* Strong organization, ownership, and attention to detail, with the judgment to handle confidential information and the discipline to maintain reliable database records.
* A customer\-service mindset and willingness to support scheduled after\-hours or weekend work and rotational on\-call coverage when global business needs require it.
* Proficiency in Outlook, Excel, Word, Boolean search techniques, and structured database research, combined with genuine commitment to compliance and conflicts\-of\-interest controls.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Join a rapidly scaling India capability center that works alongside global case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership, giving legal operations professionals exposure beyond traditional back\-office support.
* Build expertise in conflicts management, ethical risk, and global business intake while collaborating with attorneys and stakeholders across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
* Grow in a meritocratic culture that combines entrepreneurial ownership, continuous learning, on\-the\-job development, and meaningful opportunities to expand your professional capabilities.
* Contribute to a firm where integrity, quality, objectivity, inclusive diversity, and personal reward guide how teams work and how individual impact is recognized.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A structured performance development process, continuous learning, and on\-the\-job training designed to support professional growth and career progression.
* Exposure to global teams, diverse industries, and complex client\-delivery environments within a rapidly growing 1,000\+ member India capability center.
* An entrepreneurial and collaborative culture that values independent thinking, meaningful ownership, inclusion, and practical impact.
* Benefits and well\-being resources that support employees’ professional development and personal journey.

title: Contract Logistics Human Resources Specialist
description:
**It's more than a job**
 As part of the Contract Logistics team at Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in designing, managing, and optimizing solutions that keep goods moving efficiently. Whether you’re leading a team, engineering processes, or driving projects, your work ensures that our customers’ products are stored, handled, and delivered with precision. From everyday essentials to seasonal items, what we do in Contract Logistics impacts businesses and communities around the world. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your contribution goes far beyond the warehouse—it helps shape the flow of global trade.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 You will be part of our Contract Logistics team, adding your expertise \+ skills to support Customer \+ Operational Excellence by ensuring Labour Law compliance and Statutory adherence across all warehouses and offices.
   

  

 Your primary objective will be to ensure compliance with labour laws and statutory requirements, supporting smooth operations and minimizing compliance risks across sites.
   

  

**How you create impact**
* To ensure compliance with central and state labour laws including CLRA, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, Shops \& Establishment, PF, ESI, etc.
* To manage and monitor contract labour compliance, including vendor documentation, statutory validations, and adherence checks
* To maintain and update statutory registers, records, filings, and compliance trackers across all locations
* To support execution of internal and external audits, including documentation, site readiness, and closure tracking of observations
* To track and manage audit findings and ensure timely closure in coordination with site teams
* To support statutory licensing processes, including applications, renewals, and documentation management
* To track and update labour law changes and regulatory requirements, ensuring timely communication and implementation support
* To coordinate with government authorities and inspectors for documentation, inspections, and follow\-ups
* To support payroll compliance checks, including validation of minimum wages, statutory deductions, and contractor compliance
* To monitor and validate vendor compliance documentation on an ongoing basis
* To support incident reporting and RCA coordination, including tracking closure timelines and documentation
* To assist in execution of training and awareness programs on labour law and compliance requirements
* To support compliance readiness for new customer onboarding, including documentation, checklist validation, and site\-level coordination


**What we would like you to bring**
* 10–12 years of experience in Labour Compliance and Industrial Relations (IR) within logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, or supply chain environments.
* Strong knowledge of labour laws including CLRA, PF, ESIC, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, Factory Act, and Labour Codes.
* Experience managing contract labour and manpower vendor compliance.
* Proven ability to conduct statutory and labour compliance audits across multiple sites.
* Hands\-on experience handling employee grievances, labour disputes, strikes, and workforce disruptions.
* Strong liaison and relationship management with labour authorities, government bodies, and external stakeholders.
* Experience validating payroll compliance, statutory deductions, and employee remuneration.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage customers, vendors, and operations teams.
* Willingness to travel extensively and support on\-site operational requirements.
* LLB/LLM or Labour Law qualification preferred; experience with large logistics or e\-commerce organizations is highly desirable.


**What's in it for you**
* Work with a Global Leader – Join one of the world’s top logistics companies with a strong international presence and reputation.
* Career Development – Access structured growth opportunities, professional training, and internal mobility within a global organization.
* Attractive Compensation – Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives and benefits.
* Collaborative Work Culture – Be part of a supportive, ethical, and compliance\-driven team environment.
* Local Role, Global Impact – Influence regional business growth while working with global tools, systems, and best practices.


**Who we are**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Head - Contracting -
description:
**Job Purpose**
 The Head – Contracting, owns Business \-level Contracting standards and governance, with a primary focus on high\-value and critical contracts. The role holder is accountable for sector specific clause library outcomes, template and playbook standardization for the related business, contract risk frameworks, regulatory\-aligned processes, and sector\-informed guidance so that business units operate within defined risk appetite while achieving commercial objectives.
   

  

 Additionally, the role Ensure all executed contracts and key metadata (obligations, SLAs, LD triggers, price revisions, securities, insurance, extensions) are accurately captured in CLM / contract repository and appropriately interfaced with business systems (e.g., SAP, billing, project controls) for critical contracts.
   

  

 Drive periodic contract performance reviews with Business, Projects, Procurement, Finance, and Operations to track performance against scope, time, cost, quality, and risk commitments for critical and high‑value contracts, and agree corrective actions.
   

  

 Monitor compliance with contractual obligations (both GMR and counterparty) for critical contracts, including notices, conditions precedent, approvals, insurance renewals, bank guarantees, and change control, and escalate non‑compliances.
   

  

****ORGANISATION CHART****
 EVP \- Contracts \& Compliance \-\-\> Head\- Contracting
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Accountability / Focus Area**
**Key Activities**
 Clause Library Ownership \& Quality
   

  

* Build, maintain, and expand a Group/Business\-wide clause library for commercial, legal, technical, and compliance risk areas.
* Own lifecycle of clauses including fallback: design, approval, deployment,.
* Convert fallout / lessons from Contracting into updated clauses and positions.


 Governance, Version Control \& Auditability
   

  

* Establish and operate governance for clause creation, amendment, approvals, and version control.
* Institutionalise CLM as single source of truth for approved clauses, templates, and playbooks with traceable history.
* Provide audit\-ready documentation and dashboards for pre\-contract governance, especially for critical contracts.


 Standardization of Templates \& Playbooks
   

  

* Develop and maintain standardized templates, drafting guidelines, and negotiation playbooks for key contract types and risk categories.
* Drive adoption of templates and playbooks across BUs; \- Control template proliferation and formalize criteria for non\-standard use in critical contracts.


 Risk Assessment \& Mitigation for Critical Contracts
   

  

* Define framework for identifying critical contracts and associated risk thresholds.
* Approve risk mitigation plans for critical contracts.
* Maintain pre\-contract risk registers and link risks to clauses, templates, and approval thresholds.


 Role in Negotiation Bottlenecks (Critical Contracts)
   

  

* Advise negotiation teams in bottleneck situations on risk positions, fallback options, and internal alignment for critical contracts.
* Provide structured decision support without owning day\-to\-day drafting or frontline negotiations.
* Feed recurring negotiation bottlenecks back into playbooks and standards.


**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Additional Details**
 Regulatory \& Policy Compliance in Contracting
   

  

* Embed applicable laws and regulations (GST, RBI, sectoral, local labor, etc.) into templates, clauses, checklists, and workflows.
* Coordinate periodic reviews with Legal, Tax, Compliance, HR to reflect regulatory changes.
* Own and update Group policies and standards governing Contracting and use of clauses/templates.


 Cross\-Functional Engagement \& Workshops
   

  

* Lead cross\-functional forums with Legal, Procurement, Finance, Risk, Operations, and Business for standards, positions, and risk discussions on critical contracts.
* Translate outcomes into updated artefacts and actions with clear owners and timelines.
* Act as single point of accountability for reconciling BU needs with Group standards.


 Training, Adoption \& Change Management
   

  

* Design and roll out training programs on clause library, templates, playbooks, and risk frameworks for all relevant functions.
* Drive adoption metrics and behavioural change; publish performance reports and improvement plans if any.
* Communicate changes and implications for all stakeholders involved in critical contracts.


 Contracting Governance \& Performance Management
   

  

* Set up and operate a structured framework for handover of signed contracts to business owners, including allocation of obligation owners, milestones, and KPIs for critical and high‑value contracts.
* Ensure all executed contracts and key metadata (obligations, SLAs, LD triggers, price revisions, securities, insurance, extensions) are accurately captured in CLM / contract repository and interfaced with business systems (e.g., SAP, billing, project controls) for critical contracts.
* Drive periodic post‑award contract performance reviews with Business, Projects, Procurement, Finance, and Operations to track performance against scope, time, cost, quality, and risk commitments for critical and high‑value contracts, and agree corrective actions.
* Monitor compliance with contractual obligations (both GMR and counterparty) for critical contracts, including notices, conditions precedent, approvals, insurance renewals, bank guarantees, and change control, and escalate non‑compliances.
* Establish and oversee mechanisms for managing variations, claims, disputes, extensions of time, price escalations, and contractual reliefs in coordination with Legal and Business for critical contracts.
* Analyse post‑award issues, claims, and disputes and translate lessons learned into strengthened clause library, templates, playbooks, and risk frameworks.
* Provide post‑award advisory to business leadership on exercise of contractual levers (LDs, incentives, termination, step‑in, audit rights, service credits) for critical and high‑risk contracts.
* Ensure timely and controlled contract close‑out for major contracts, including defect‑liability obligations, warranties, document handback, securities release, and final account / reconciliation.


****EXTERNAL INTERACTIONS****
* There will not be any direct interaction with the external parties however participation with vendor/ client/ government stakeholder along with legal, procurement, business team etc. as and when required.


****INTERNAL INTERACTIONS****
* GMR Procurement team, GMR Legal team, GMR Finance team, GMR Operations team, GMR Business team for various sector such as airport, energy etc.


****FINANCIAL DIMENSIONS****
* NA


**Other Dimensions**
* NA


**Education Qualifications**
 LLB from a reputed institution or LLM/PG Diploma in Business Law, or Contract Management certification is a plus.
   

  

**Relevant Experience**
* 12–15 years of contracts / legal / commercial experience, with substantial exposure to at least one of Airport, Energy, Land Development, Sports,
* Proven leadership in pre\-contract governance, risk frameworks, and critical contracts in complex, multi\-BU settings.
* Experience with CLM / digital contracting and data\-driven reporting on deviations, risks, and adoption.


****COMPETENCIES****
* Capability Building
* Strategic Orientation
* Social Awareness
* Entrepreneurship
* Execution \& Results
* Teamwork \& Interpersonal influence
* Problem Solving \& Analytical Thinking
* Planning \& Decision Making
* Personal Effectiveness
* Stakeholder Focus
* Networking

title: Regulatory Affairs & Policy Specialist
description:
**About The Role:** 
 A high\-impact specialist role at the intersection of technology, telecom regulation, data privacy and business strategy. The role will translate evolving regulations into actionable guidance for Product, Engineering, Operations and business teams, ensuring regulatory readiness across Tanla’s platforms and offerings. The individual will also serve as a trusted advisor for CXOs and enterprise customers, and represent Tanla in regulatory engagements, audits, escalations and high\-stakes matters. The role will help turn regulatory compliance and trust into a business enabler and competitive differentiator.
 



  





**What You’ll be Responsible for?** 




**1\. Operationalizing Regulation** 



* **Product Collaboration:** 
 Partner with Product and Engineering teams to ensure Tanla platforms/products are compliant to regulations. Act as the bridge to help technical teams understand regulatory requirements and ensure new product features are compliant before launch.
* **SOP Development:** 
 Convert complex regulatory frameworks (such as the DPDP Act and TRAI regulations) into clear, actionable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for internal teams.



**2\. Governance \& Executive Advisory** 



* **Executive Liaison:** 
 Serve as the lead point of contact for CXOs/HoDs across Tanla group regarding telecom regulatory readiness, risk assessments, and strategic compliance updates.
* **Audit:** 
 Assist in internal and external audits on regulatory risks, ensuring the organization consistently meets and exceeds regulatory requirements.



**3\. Customer Trust \& Audit Escalation** 



* **Escalation Authority:** 
 Act as the escalation point for enterprise customers regarding regulatory inquiries and audit requests.
* **Client Confidence:** 
 Provide expert, high\-stakes responses to client queries, building long\-term trust and confidence in Tanla’s regulatory integrity.



**4\. Crisis Management \& External Representation** 



* **Regulatory Response:** 
 Lead the organization’s response to regulators and enforcement agencies during inquiries, inspections, or incidents.
* **Crisis Coordination:** 
 Manage time\-sensitive crises by coordinating with legal, marketing, operations, and technical teams to mitigate risks and safeguard the company’s reputation.



  





**5\. Commercial Enablement** 



* **Strategic Growth:** 
 Work with Sales and Marketing to position Tanla’s adherence to global and local regulations as a key competitive differentiator.
* **Value Creation:** 
 Reframe regulatory compliance from a cost center into a powerful sales enabler that helps win and retain top\-tier enterprise clients.



**What We’re Looking For in You?** 



* **Experience:** 
 10–15\+ years in Tech\-Policy, Data Privacy, or Regulatory Affairs within regulated tech or telecom ecosystem.
* **Deep Knowledge:** 
 Expert\-level understanding of the DPDP Act 2023 and technology regulations. Prior experience with TRAI regulations such as TCCCPR 2018 and MeitY guidelines is preferred.
* **Communication:** 
 Ability to translate technical and legal concepts into simple, commercial language for diverse stakeholders (developers, sales/marketing, board members). Previous experience reporting to Board/CXO levels is preferred.
* **Strategic Mindset:** 
 A proven track record of handling product development requirements, high\-pressure regulatory audits and resolving complex customer escalations. Prior experience of directly engaging with regulators is highly preferred.



**Why join us?** 



* **Impactful Work:** 
 Play a pivotal role in safeguarding Tanla's assets, data, and reputation in the industry.
* **Tremendous Growth Opportunities** 
 : Be part of a rapidly growing company in the telecom and CPaaS space, with opportunities for professional development.
* **Innovative Environment:** 
 Work alongside a world\-class team in a challenging and fun environment, where innovation is celebrated.



  





 Tanla is an equal opportunity employer. We champion diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
 



  





**www.tanla.com**

title: Associate Director – Government Affairs (North)
description:
Associate Director – Government Affairs (North)
 



 Corporate Affairs \- Government Affairs
 



 JOB DESCRIPTION
 



 We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Government Affairs professional to lead stakeholder engagement, regulatory affairs, and business\-critical government relations across key North Indian markets.
 



 The role will be responsible for securing operational approvals, managing regulatory compliance, driving policy advocacy initiatives, and building strong partnerships with government stakeholders to support the company's growth ambitions. The candidate will play a critical role in shaping a favorable business environment, enabling market access, and ensuring seamless brewery and commercial operations.
 



 This position requires a strong understanding of state excise policies, regulatory frameworks, and government processes, coupled with the ability to engage credibly with senior government officials, industry bodies, and internal business leaders.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
 :
 



 Government Relations \& Stakeholder Engagement
 


* Build and maintain strong relationships with senior government officials, regulatory authorities, industry associations, and key external stakeholders.
* Represent AB InBev India before state government departments, excise authorities, local administrations, and relevant regulatory bodies.
* Engage proactively with policymakers on issues impacting the beer industry and broader business environment.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen partnerships with government stakeholders and contribute to policy dialogue.



 Regulatory Affairs \& Business Continuity
 


* Secure and manage all operational approvals required for brewery and commercial operations, including:
* Excise licenses
* Label registrations
* Export permissions
* Brewery approvals
* Trade licenses
* Shifts and capacity approvals
* Other statutory permissions
* Ensure timely regulatory submissions and compliance with applicable state excise regulations and government requirements.
* Manage end\-to\-end resolution of operational and regulatory issues impacting business continuity.
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess potential business implications.



 Policy Advocacy \& Ease of Doing Business
 


* Track emerging policy, regulatory, and industry developments across key states.
* Support the development and execution of advocacy strategies to improve market access and ease of doing business.
* Partner with industry associations and government stakeholders on issues related to taxation, regulatory modernization, digitization, and operational efficiency.
* Provide insights and recommendations to internal leadership on policy developments and regulatory risks.



 Cross\-Functional Business Partnering
 


* Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Tax, Legal, Procurement, Logistics, Sustainability, Marketing, and People teams to support business objectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor on government affairs and regulatory matters.
* Support new investments, capacity expansions, and strategic business initiatives requiring government engagement.



 Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure adherence to all applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Draft and review official correspondence, applications, submissions, and representations to government authorities.
* Maintain high standards of integrity, transparency, and corporate governance in all stakeholder interactions.
* Support audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews as required.



 Key Internal Relationships
 


* Sales \& Commercial
* Supply Chain Operations
* Logistics
* Procurement
* Marketing
* Sustainability and Agro
* New Business Development
* Corporate Communication Team
* Finance \& Tax
* HR



**Key External Relationships** 



* State Excise Departments
* Senior Bureaucrats and Government Officials
* Local Administration and Municipal Authorities
* Pollution Control Boards
* Labour and Factory Departments
* Industry Associations and Trade Bodies
* Licensing and Regulatory Authorities



 Education level and/ or experience
 


* Graduate/Postgraduate in any stream
* Degree in Law, Public Policy, Political Science, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred.
* 8\+ years of work experience in Government Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Public Policy, Corporate Affairs or related functions
* Experience engaging with state and central government stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of excise regulations, licensing frameworks, and regulatory processes.
* Prior experience in FMCG, beverages, consumer goods, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, or regulated industries preferred.



 Skills and/or knowledge
 


* High energy, Solution\-oriented and positive attitude
* Exceptional customer orientation
* Fast\-mover, quick to adapt
* Flexibility and resilience in a fast\-moving environment
* Integrity and professionalism
* Excellent communication skills \- written, verbal and presentation
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and assess priorities effectively
* Essential computer operating skills – including MS\-Office applications

 Loop is a subscription management platform built for e\-commerce brands on Shopify. Our primary market is the US, with growing presence in Europe and ANZ.
   

  

 We are scaling rapidly, driven by a strong product and exceptional merchant experience. We achieved :3x growth in 2024, followed by nearly 3x growth again in 2025\. Looking ahead, we are building the team and foundation to drive another 2x growth in 2026 as we accelerate toward our $50M goal.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is Loop's first dedicated legal hire and an important step in building the legal function. You will work directly with the Chief of Staff, own day\-to\-day legal execution, and build the templates, playbooks and SOPs that protect the company as it scales. We are looking for someone who wants to build with the team over the long term and retain ownership of the systems they create. This position will work on derisking and actively work with Sales, marketing, product, and finance team to remove legal roadblocks.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Commercial contracts. Draft, review and negotiate SaaS MSAs, Order Forms, DPAs, NDAs, vendor, partner and other business agreements.
* Merchant negotiations. Lead issue\-based calls with merchants and their counsel, understand the commercial concern, explain Loop's position and agree workable fallbacks.
* Contract standards. Maintain templates and clause positions for legal or regulatory changes; periodically redesign the contract suite to remove inconsistencies, reflect negotiation history and improve clarity.
* Privacy and data. Support compliance with the EU GDPR, UK GDPR and applicable US state privacy laws; align the MSA, DPA, privacy notices, and incident obligations.
* Product and consumer rules. Assess cookie and tracking requirements, API and data\-access terms, and subscription, auto\-renewal and cancellation rules across relevant markets; translate findings into product and contract actions.
* Security and assurance. Partner with Engineering, Security and Operations on PCI DSS responsibilities, SOC 2 readiness, customer security reviews and the legal evidence needed for audits.
* IP employment and general advisory. Support IP protection and licensing, HR policies, employment and consultant documents, and routine business contract reviews.
* Legal operations and risk discovery. Create intake, approval, escalation, repository and obligation\-tracking SOPs. Proactively identify legal risks that the business has not yet considered, rank them and drive practical mitigation with internal teams or external counsel.


**Ideal Profile**
* Law degree from a recognized institution and 2 to 5 years of relevant experience.
* Hands\-on commercial contract drafting and negotiation experience; SaaS, technology or in\-house exposure is strongly preferred.
* Ability to research unfamiliar multi\-jurisdictional questions, separate legal requirements from business preferences and give a clear recommendation.
* Comfort speaking directly with merchants, business teams and technical stakeholders.
* Strong drafting discipline, attention to detail and judgment on when to accept, negotiate or escalate risk.
* Ownership mindset


**Perks**
* Annual Leaves
* Free lunch and snacks
* Annual company retreat

title: Legal Manager - Contracts
description:

 We are looking for a Legal Manager \- Contracts who will lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial agreements across the organisation and manage coordination with external legal counsel.
   

  

 The role will work closely with business, procurement, partnerships, logistics, finance, and leadership teams to ensure contracts are structured efficiently while protecting Agrim’s legal and commercial interests.

* Ensure contracts adequately address risk allocation, liability, indemnities, and compliance requirements.

* Build and maintain internal contract playbooks and negotiation guidelines.
* Track contract approvals, execution, and renewals.

 Candidate Profile
   

  

**Experience**
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in corporate advisory/commercial contracts
* Law firm or in\-house experience preferably at growth stage companies


 Education
   

  

* LLB from a recognised university


**Skills**
* Strong contract drafting and negotiation capability
* Ability to translate legal risks into business decisions
* Strong stakeholder management skills
* Attention to detail with commercial thinking


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

**Someone Who Can**
* Act as a business partner, not just a legal reviewer
* Move quickly while maintaining legal discipline
* Build scalable contract processes as Agrim grows

title: Contracts Professional
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 As a Contracts Professional within the Global Contracting Center (GCC), you will partner closely with the Contract Management Group, Legal, Sales, Business Operations, and Project Delivery teams throughout the contract lifecycle. You will serve as a trusted advisor on contractual matters, supporting commercial objectives while ensuring appropriate risk identification, assessment, and mitigation.
   

  

 This role requires a commercially focused legal professional with strong contract review, drafting, negotiation, and analytical skills who can independently manage a broad range of client\-facing agreements and support strategic business initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Review, draft, redline, and negotiate client contracts, amendments, subcontract agreements, task orders, change requests, non\-disclosure agreements, teaming agreements, and other commercial documents.
* Support RFP, RFQ, and tender reviews from a contractual and compliance perspective.
* Prepare contract summaries, representation \& certification memo, risk assessments, and briefing notes for internal reviews and approvals.
* Identify contractual, legal, and commercial risks and propose solutions consistent with company policies and risk profile.
* Support business teams during contract negotiations with customers and project stakeholders.
* Assist Regional Legal Counsel with complex contractual issues and escalations.


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Law Graduate/LL.B., from a recognized university with 5\-7 years of relevant post\-qualification experience in contract review, drafting and negotiation.
* Demonstrated experience supporting preferably seller side contracting for professional services, engineering, consulting, technology, construction, or infrastructure organizations.
* Preferred experience in reviewing and negotiating public sector customer facing commercial agreements.
* Advanced understanding of contract law principles, risk allocation provisions, compliance framework and commercial contracting practices.
* Experience in interpreting RFPs, RFQs, client terms and conditions, and contractual requirements.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with global stakeholders, including legal, contracting, and business teams.
* Experience working with contract lifecycle management platforms (e.g., Icertis, SAP Ariba)
* Experience working in an in\-house legal department, shared services center or environment supporting global stakeholders.
* Demonstrate ability to independently manage a high volume of contract reviews and negotiations with minimal supervision.
* Team player having strong written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to communicate complex contractual concepts clearly and concisely.
* Provide guidance and day\-to\-day support to junior contracting professionals and assist with knowledge sharing and process improvement initiatives within the GCC.
* Strong analytical, organizational, stakeholder management capabilities, ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

description:

**Preferred Qualifications consist of**

title: Manager/ Senior Manager | Employee Relations
description:
Join our Asia Regional People \& Culture team within our Employee Relations (ER) team responsible for providing legal advice and support around employment\-related matters in India (Gurugram and Mumbai). Reporting to the Employee Relations Lead based in Hong Kong, this role will work with staff at all levels in Gurugram, Hyderabad and Mumbai.
   

  

 We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
   

  

**What role will you play?**
 In this role, you will provide strategic employee relations advice across the full employment lifecycle, supporting matters such as performance management, terminations, restructures, mergers and acquisitions, employment documentation, and litigation risk management. As Macquarie undergoes significant organisational change, you will play a key role in driving employee relations and employment law initiatives across India while contributing to regional and global priorities and helping shape the future of work. Partnering closely with P\&C Business Partners and Country P\&C, you will oversee workplace behaviour and equal employment opportunity matters, including employee consultations, complaints, investigations, and the implementation of appropriate outcomes.
   

  

**What You Offer**
* Tertiary qualification in a relevant field (Law degree or equivalent strongly preferred)
* Proven experience of 10\+ years working either in private practice covering employment law or within a Human Resources function providing consultative Employee Relations advice to stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to deliver both on the transactional day to day work as well as the strategic and advisory work
* You will have a minimum of two to five years of employment law experience with a thorough understanding of employment law frameworks in India.
* Demonstrative ability to lead and adapt to change, with experience leveraging AI tools and technologies considered highly desirable.
* High level of integrity, excellent attention to detail, flexibility in your approach to work, as well as the ability to adapt to a constantly changing environment.


 We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
 At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
   

  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company\-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment


**About Financial Management, People and Engagement**
 Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) provides a single interface for Macquarie’s businesses across key areas of people, strategy, communications and financial management. Comprising two pillars – Financial Management, and People and Engagement – it is responsible for managing the Group’s financial, tax and treasury activities and strategic priorities, fostering our culture through people and community engagement strategies, and engaging with stakeholders to protect and promote Macquarie’s reputation globally.
   

  

**Inclusion at Macquarie**
 We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.

title: Associate, Compliance (Content Review)
description:
**Position Overview**
 We are seeking candidates for an Associate role on our Compliance team supporting the Global Content Review function. This is a hybrid office/remote role with in\-office time in Gurugram.
   

  

**Overview Of GLG Compliance**
 Compliance is foundational to GLG’s business and our culture. Our unparalleled compliance systems and technologies provide a structured, auditable, and transparent way for our clients to receive actionable insights from GLG experts in a manner that is consistent with the highest professional standards and best practices.
   

  

 GLG clients value our experts for their knowledge and insights, but they also recognize and respect that there are certain constraints on the information our experts can share. GLG’s Compliance team \- via our systems and compliance framework \- help protect our clients by mitigating the risk of inadvertently soliciting or receiving confidential information from our experts and controlling the type of client information that is shared with experts.
   

  

 GLG’s Compliance team comprises more than 70 professionals around the globe. It is led by our General Counsel, Laurence Herman, who has more than two decades of industry experience, and our Chief Compliance Officer, Cohan, who has 18 years of regulatory experience.
   

  

**Overview of the Role:**
 As a Compliance Associate on GLG’s Global Content Review team, you will play a critical role in maintaining the integrity of our transcript library and live content offerings. Collaborating with colleagues across the globe, you will apply your research skills and risk assessment expertise to review content programming submissions and event transcripts. The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical abilities, sound judgment, and the confidence to address escalations with thoughtful, compliance\-driven solutions that support business goals appropriately.
   

  

 This role requires a self\-motivated professional who thrives in a dynamic, collaborative environment and is adept at engaging stakeholders across levels and functions. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are essential.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Evaluate the scope and appropriateness of various GLG event programming, ensuring alignment with our compliance framework.
* Collaborate with global colleagues to enforce and uphold compliance policies.
* Partner with your team and manager to identify opportunities to enhance review and approval processes.
* Provide clear, articulate, and practical guidance to stakeholders on compliance\-related issues.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks, demonstrating initiative and independence in a fast\-paced environment.
* Candidates with either legal/compliance, financial and/or professional client\-facing backgrounds will be preferred.


**The Ideal Candidate Will Have The Following Attributes**
* Graduate/post\-graduate degree with 3\-5 years of work experience;
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
* Must be well organized with an ability to multi\-task and prioritize effectively, while ensuring a high level of accuracy and attention to detail;
* Must be reliable and consistent with a high level of professionalism;
* Ability to use good judgment and maintain confidentiality as needed;
* Proactive, self\-motivated and eager to work in a collaborative environment;
* Strong analytical and writing skills with an ability to make complex concepts accessible to different audiences;
* Ability to work effectively and independently from a remote location, and also willingness to work from the office some of the time, and
* Full business proficiency in English.


**About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group**
 GLG is the world’s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision\-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.
   

  

 At GLG, you are an extension of our clients' core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high\-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry’s most trusted research environment, you’ll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes.
   

  

 We are a global team of pragmatic problem\-solvers who mirror the intensity of the markets we serve. If you are driven by intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action, join us in reinventing the industry we invented.
   

  

 Gerson Lehrman Group, Inc. (“GLG”) is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, race, religion, color, marital status, disability, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classification protected by federal, state, or local law.
