title: Legal Associate
description:
Number of Positions\-2
   

  

 The All India Football Federation (AIFF) invites applications for the position of Legal Associate on a contractual basis at its Headquarters, Football House, New Delhi.
   

  

 The Legal, Regulatory and Governance Department is responsible for advising and supporting the Federation on a wide range of disciplinary, governance, regulatory, commercial, contractual, litigation and other legal matters arising from the administration and development of football in India.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work closely with the Legal Department and will gain exposure to the legal and regulatory framework governing a national sporting federation, including matters involving AIFF regulations, FIFA and AFC regulations, contractual arrangements, disciplinary proceedings, governance, litigation and sports\-related commercial matters.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The Legal Assistant will be expected to assist the Legal, Regulatory and Governance Department in the following areas:
   

  

* Legal Drafting \& Documentation
* Assist in the drafting, reviewing, formatting and finalisation of legal documents, correspondence, notices, agreements and other legal instruments.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing service agreements, sponsorship and partnership agreements, licensing arrangements, commercial contracts, consultancy agreements, tenders, addenda, corrigenda and other contractual documentation.
* Prepare legal briefs, notes, summaries, chronologies and other documentation required by the Legal Department.
* Regulatory \& Governance Matters
* Assist in the drafting, review and revision of AIFF regulations, policies, circulars, guidelines and other governance documents.
* Conduct legal and regulatory research on matters concerning the AIFF Constitution, FIFA and AFC regulations, applicable Indian laws and sports\-governance frameworks.
* Assist in reviewing Federation policies and procedures to identify potential legal, regulatory and compliance risks and ensure that the Federation’s interests are adequately protected.
* Disciplinary \& Sports Regulatory Matters
* Assist in matters relating to disciplinary proceedings, appeals, player status, registration, transfers and other regulatory disputes.
* Assist in the work of AIFF committees and bodies dealing with disciplinary, ethics, appeal and other regulatory matters, as required.
* Litigation, Arbitration \& External Counsel Coordination
* Assist the Legal Department in coordinating with external advocates, law firms and legal counsel engaged by the Federation.
* Assist in compiling documents, factual briefs, legal records and instructions required by external legal counsel in connection with court proceedings, arbitration, sports disputes and proceedings before the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS).
* Track ongoing legal matters, hearings, deadlines, filings and instructions and assist in ensuring timely coordination between the Federation and its external counsel.
* Assist in legal research and preparation of materials for litigation and other dispute\-resolution proceedings.
* Commercial \& Contractual Matters
* Assist in reviewing commercial arrangements undertaken by the Federation, including sponsorship, partnership, licensing, branding, media, service\-provider and other commercial agreements.
* Assist in identifying contractual, compliance and legal risks and ensure that the Federation’s interests are appropriately safeguarded.
* Assist in reviewing tenders, RFPs, bid documents, contractual terms and related communications from a legal and compliance perspective.
* Legal Research \& Advisory Support
* Conduct research on Indian sports law, commercial law, employment law, intellectual property, competition law, data protection, consumer protection and other areas relevant to the Federation’s operations.
* Research and analyse FIFA, AFC and other international sporting regulations and their application to matters before the Federation.
* Prepare legal research notes and assist senior members of the Department in developing legal positions and recommendations.
* Departmental \& Federation Support
* Assist the Legal Department in responding to legal queries received from various departments, Member Associations, clubs, players, officials, service providers and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal departments to obtain relevant information and documentation for legal matters.
* Assist in monitoring compliance with contractual, regulatory and statutory obligations.
* Undertake such other legal, regulatory, governance and administrative responsibilities as may be assigned by the Department from time to time.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Educational Qualification**
* LL.B. / B.A. LL.B. / B.B.A. LL.B. or an equivalent recognised law degree.


**Professional Experience**
* Candidates with 0–2 years of Post\-Qualification Experience (PQE) are particularly encouraged to apply.
* Fresh law graduates with relevant internships and a demonstrated interest in sports law, football governance, commercial law or regulatory matters will also be considered.
* Prior internship or work experience in sports law, commercial law, litigation, regulatory law or corporate law will be an advantage.
* Candidates with experience in or familiarity with FIFA and AFC regulations, sports governance, disciplinary regulations, player regulations or CAS proceedings will be preferred.


**Core Skills**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent legal drafting, proofreading and research abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle multiple assignments and work within tight timelines.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound professional judgment.


**How To Apply**
 Please fill in the Google form link below to send the applications in soft copy.
   

  

 https://forms.gle/CpE74p28P66KFJGo7
   

  

 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview, the date and time of which will be communicated via email.
   

  

 AIFF reserves the right to cancel/reject the vacancy or applications without assigning any reason.

description:

Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

**About The Team**
 Tegus by AlphaSense facilitates extremely valuable calls between our clients and experts. Given the proprietary insights in these conversations, compliance is critical to our business, and a key component of our value add. The Compliance Team provides our clients with actionable insights while maintaining the highest legal and regulatory standards.

 This role will be part of our growing India Compliance Review team, providing critical coverage across global time zones to help ensure 24x5 compliance review support for our U.S. and international operations. This role is fast\-paced, so agility and ability to work under a tight deadline are key.

* Conduct advanced research of financial reports and regulatory filings using internal databases and external resources to determine the extent to which information exists in the public domain.
* Proactively manage internal and external communications while maintaining efficiency and adaptability in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive environment.
* Perform administrative tasks, including but not limited to, inputting, tracking, and maintaining accurate data on processes, transcripts, and workflows, while identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks, manage time, and remain highly organized while working independently.

title: Associate Legal Advisor
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
 Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation\-owned people company. We have more than 20,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning \& Urban Design, Water, Environment \& Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
   

  

**Ramboll globally**
 Ramboll is a leading engineering, architecture and consultancy company. Working at one of our offices in 35 countries you will join 16,000 fellow bright minds in creating innovative and sustainable solutions within Buildings, Transport, Energy, Environment \& Health, Architecture, Landscape \& Urbanism, Water and Management Consulting. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the society of tomorrow.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Join our Global Legal Operations (GLO) team!**
 Ramboll's Global Legal Operations (GLO) team provides centralized legal services to our businesses operating in regions with a smaller Ramboll presence, as well as supporting legal teams across continental Europe, APAC, India, UK, and the US. Our GLO team members are based in India and Europe. We are seeking a full\-time Legal Advisor specializing in Contracts matters to join our growing team. The primary focus of this role is reviewing consultancy contracts with clients and advising our internal client base. The team also handles professional indemnity insurance, claims, and corporate/company secretarial support for designated regions.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities:**
* Review contracts and other legal documents, identifying and communicating potential legal implications to project and local legal teams.
* Draft, review, and modify contractual instruments to support various business activities.
* Negotiate, review, and draft documentation for business transactions, including developing and advising on checklists to ensure timely information submission.
* Review and redline contracts and other project legal documents from various jurisdictions (overflow support), contributing to knowledge management for these requests.
* Provide legal information and interpretation, conduct training, and communicate relevant legal requirements to concerned staff.
* Adhere to Ramboll's internal policies and governance, providing guidance to stakeholders.


**Key Deliverables (First 24 Months):**
* Service Management \- Contracts: Collaborate with the GLO team to ensure timely, high\-quality, pragmatic responses aligned with Ramboll governance.
* Stakeholder Management: Develop strong working relationships with Tender Managers and Company Directors within Ramboll entities.


**Your Starting Point for Growth:**
 At Ramboll, we are committed to your professional development. For this role, we seek candidates with the following qualifications and experience:
   

  

  

* Legal qualifications (LLB or equivalent) with at least 4\+ years of relevant experience.
* Prior in\-house legal experience within a consultancy or engineering company in the construction, environmental, or infrastructure industry.
* Proven experience in contract drafting and redlining international contracts, applying commercial acumen to contract review and advice.
* Working knowledge of professional indemnity insurance, workmen's compensation insurance, and third\-party liability insurance.
* Excellent communication and drafting skills.
* Ability to create and deliver PowerPoint presentations.
* Strong self\-learning and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse cultures and interact with all organizational levels.
* Ability to work under pressure and be results\-oriented.


**Personal Qualities for Success:**
 The ideal candidate will possess the following personal attributes:
   

  

  

* Ability to work effectively with people from diverse cultures and at all levels of the organization.
* Strong workload and people management skills.
* Ability to apply a commercial and pragmatic approach when advising on contracts in foreign jurisdictions.


**Qualifications**
 Qualification: LLB
   

  

 Mandatory Skills Requires: Contract Management, Legal advising, Risk Management,
   

  

 Insurance, Dispute \& resolution, teamwork, stakeholder management
   

  

 Software Skills: MS Office, Teams Contract Management tools, CRM
   

  

 Experience: 6\-9 year
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Ramboll is a leading engineering, architecture and consultancy company. Working at one of our offices in 35 countries you will join 18,000 fellow bright minds in creating innovative and sustainable solutions within Buildings, Transport, Energy, Environment \& Health, Architecture, Landscape \& Urbanism, Water and Management Consulting. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the society of tomorrow.
   

  

**About You**
 From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. Whilst we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, and capabilities that will set you up for success.
   

  

**What We Can Offer You**
* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are
* Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
* The long\-term thinking of a foundation\-owned company


**Work at the heart of sustainable change**
 Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realise their full potential.
   

  

**Ready to join us?**
 Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc.
   

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion is at the heart of what we do**
 We believe in the strength of diversity and know that unique experiences and perspectives are vital for creating truly sustainable societies. Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to contact our recruitment team to discuss any accommodations you need during the application process.

title: Global Supplier Risk & Governance Director
description:
**Locations** 
 : Lisbon \| Gurgaon
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Enterprise Services (ES) was established in 2022 to provide efficient, resilient, and scalable services to support the evolving needs and complexities of a more digital BCG. ES brings together business\-critical operations \- such as Procurement \& Payables, Global Finance Operations, and Executive Support Services \- alongside specialist expertise including Real Estate, Travel, and Meetings \& Events. United by a common service mindset, ES enables every BCGer to focus on the work that matters most by giving time and energy back through streamlined, reliable service delivery. In doing so, ES creates cost advantage and strengthens BCG’s market differentiation, while reducing risk through consistent controls and business continuity. Through scalable platforms and globally integrated ways of working across our strategic core global hubs, Enterprise Services enhances agility and helps unlock the potential of those who advance the world.
   

  

 Enterprise Procurement \& Payables (EP\&P) helps maximize value from BCG's supplier relationships while ensuring strong governance, responsible risk management, and operational resilience across the supplier lifecycle.
   

  

 As Global Supplier Risk \& Governance Director, you will lead the evolution of BCG's supplier governance capability, establishing the frameworks, operating models, and strategic programs that ensure our global supplier base remains resilient, compliant, and aligned with BCG's business priorities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Reporting to the Senior Director responsible for Strategic Supplier Management, you will shape the future direction of supplier governance across Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), ESG, supplier performance, policy, client assurance, and supplier lifecycle management. Working across Procurement, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Technology, and Enterprise Services, you will translate complex regulatory and operational requirements into scalable governance capabilities that protect BCG while enabling the business. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

**Strategic Supplier Management \& Governance**
* Define and evolve BCG's Strategic Supplier Management framework, ensuring effective governance across the supplier lifecycle.
* Lead future\-state initiatives spanning TPRM, ESG, supplier performance, supplier policy, client assurance, and supplier governance.
* Design scalable operating models that balance commercial value, operational efficiency, and enterprise risk.
* Establish governance forums, decision\-making processes, and accountability structures that strengthen supplier management across the firm.


**Risk, Policy \& Regulatory Leadership**
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Enterprise Risk, Information Security, Privacy, and other control functions to ensure supplier governance remains aligned with evolving regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
* Sponsor the development of policies, standards, guidance, and control frameworks supporting supplier governance.
* Provide strategic leadership during supplier incidents, regulatory changes, and client assurance activities.
* Ensure supplier governance capabilities continue to evolve alongside BCG's broader risk management strategy.


**Transformation, Technology \& AI**
* Lead strategic transformation initiatives that modernize supplier governance through technology, automation, and AI.
* Identify opportunities to simplify supplier management processes while improving user experience and governance effectiveness.
* Partner with Product, Technology, Data, and AI teams to embed digital capabilities across supplier management.
* Use analytics and operational insights to continuously improve governance effectiveness and supplier performance.


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to Procurement leadership and senior stakeholders across Enterprise Services.
* Build strong partnerships across regions and functions, influencing without formal authority to drive alignment and adoption.
* Lead complex cross\-functional initiatives involving Procurement, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Technology.
* Develop organizational capability by coaching colleagues, sharing expertise, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.


**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
* Designing enterprise governance frameworks that balance business enablement, compliance, and operational resilience.
* Translating strategic priorities into scalable supplier governance capabilities.
* Leading complex transformation initiatives across highly matrixed global organizations.
* Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influencing enterprise decisions.
* Applying structured problem solving to complex governance, regulatory, and operational challenges.
* Using technology, data, and AI to improve governance effectiveness and user experience.
* Communicating complex risk and governance topics clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Leading through influence while building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience leading supplier governance, procurement, third\-party risk, compliance, enterprise risk, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated success designing and implementing enterprise governance frameworks.
* Deep understanding of supplier lifecycle management, TPRM, supplier governance, ESG, or related disciplines.
* Experience leading large cross\-functional transformation initiatives in global organizations.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across regions and functions.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience leveraging technology, automation, and AI to modernize governance capabilities.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will work closely with Procurement leadership, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Operations, Enterprise Risk, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Data Privacy, Finance, Product, and Technology teams. You will also partner extensively with regional stakeholders and senior leaders across BCG to ensure supplier governance continues to evolve in support of the firm's strategic priorities.
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Manager, APAC Client Risk
description:
**Proceed with Pride** 
 is Bain’s client selection and acceptance process. Developed in partnership with our Industry and Capability Practice Areas, it helps ensure we can be proud of the work we take on. When concerns arise, Partners are encouraged to engage the Proceed with Pride team for guidance and discussion.
 





 The focus is nearly always on identifying the right mitigating actions to enable us to Proceed with Pride, although in some instances we will jointly decide not to proceed.
 





 Regional Risk Officers (RROs) have been appointed to lead Regional Risk teams to align Proceed with Pride more closely with our line leadership. RROs are experienced, independent Advisory Partners and report to our
 **Chief Risk Officer** 
 , who reports to the Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
 





 In this role, you will support the
 **Senior Manager, APAC Client Risk** 
 , and the
 **APAC RRO** 
 , helping to shape and execute the region’s approach to client selection and acceptance. You’ll be a key driver of strategic thinking and operational execution across risk efforts in the region.
 








  




**Why you’ll want to join**




* **Work at the intersection of ethics, reputation, and real\-world events:** 
 Apply critical thinking to complex topics (e.g., geopolitics, regulatory scrutiny, sensitive sectors, AI), and support senior decision\-making on whether and how Bain engages with clients and different types of work, balancing ethical and reputational trade\-offs with integrity, while protecting Bain’s values and enabling responsible growth.
* **Build a critical capability for Bain’s future:** 
 Proceed with Pride is a growing, evolving function – help shape how we manage emerging risk issues, expand our scope, and modernise how we operate at scale.
* **Direct exposure to senior leadership:** 
 Collaborate with Partners, Office Heads, Practice leaders, Legal, and PR/Comms, and support engagements with EMEA’s Regional Managing Partner (RMP) and Bain’s Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
* **Have fun!** 
 Proceed with Pride is global, yet close\-knit – be part of a collaborative and supportive team with a meaningful mission, a strong culture of camaraderie and plenty of opportunities for professional growth.







  




**Key tasks**






**1\. APAC  Client Selection and Acceptance Process – Lead and manage end\-to\-end risk assessments** 




* Monitor the APAC opportunity pipeline to identify ‘higher risk’ cases flagged by risk guidelines, including work in regulated and reputationally sensitive sectors (e.g., gambling, sensitive areas of healthcare).
* Confirm assessment requirements with Partners and facilitate in\-depth discussions on client context and strategy, reputational considerations, and risk trade\-offs.
* Conduct relevant research, frame key questions, and coordinate input from Legal, PR, and other internal experts.
* Summarise decisions and mitigation plans, monitor implementation, and evaluate outcomes to protect Bain’s reputation and enable responsible growth.







  




**2\. Risk Awareness, Education \& Engagement – Build and sustain a culture of risk mindfulness** 




* Own and produce reporting on client risk and reputational themes across APAC, highlighting strategic implications and emerging external drivers.
* Design and develop briefing materials and coordinate leadership updates for senior stakeholders (including APAC leadership and Practice Area Heads), strengthening Partners’ awareness of their role in client risk and reputation management for Bain.
* Design agendas and run regular sessions with Practice Area Managers (PAMs) to build awareness, surface risks, and strengthen risk capabilities across teams, supporting consistent decision\-making across the region.







  




**3\. Team Enablement \& Innovation – Strengthen the Proceed with Pride team through scalable, forward\-thinking solutions** 




* Support initiatives to build and evolve the team’s purpose and mission, including leveraging AI to automate processes and improve insight generation.
* Continuously refine frameworks and guidelines to remain effective in an ever\-changing, volatile environment, reflecting evolving reputational expectations and strategic priorities.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve team efficiency, collaboration, and impact through innovative tools and approaches, enabling faster, higher\-quality decisions.







  




**About you**






**Experience \& Skills** 




* 3\-6 years of professional experience in consulting, legal, audit, risk, or a similar field.
* Passion for governance and ethics, and for helping Bain decide which work to take on – strategically, reputationally, and responsibly – ensuring we can
 *Proceed with Pride* 
 .
* Strong analytical skills; ability to synthesise complex information and anticipate risks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, especially with senior leaders.
* Strong understanding of current affairs and geopolitical dynamics, and their implications for client strategy and reputational risk.







  




**Education** 




* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.







  




**Personal Attributes** 




* **Collaborative** 
 : Works effectively across teams and functions. Service\-focused.
* **Organised \& Detail\-Oriented** 
 : Keeps processes on track and ensures accuracy.
* **Pragmatic** 
 : Strong problem\-solving ability with a practical sense of what’s achievable.
* **Articulate** 
 : Communicates clearly and with impact – both verbally and in writing.
* **Team player** 
 : Passionate, reliable, and great to work with.
* **Tech\-savvy** 
 : Open to using AI tools and embracing new technologies with a growth mindset.

title: Conflict and Intake Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Conflicts \& Intake Analyst** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 4\-6 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm built around entrepreneurial, action\-oriented professionals who solve complex client problems and deliver measurable results. The firm values Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, creating a collaborative environment for independent thinkers and doers. A\&M Global Capability Center Private Limited, established in India in 2023, partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across business units and geographies. The center supports end\-to\-end client delivery and thought leadership rather than traditional back\-office work. Its teams serve the Americas, EMEA, and APAC across industries including Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The rapidly growing GCC is already a 1,000\+ member team. It combines consulting and industry expertise with specialized talent, automation, and hybrid delivery models to improve speed, scale, quality, and client value.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Conflicts \& Intake Analyst owns the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of legal conflict checks and business\-intake records for new clients, matters, and existing engagements. The role uses conflicts databases, Boolean search techniques, structured review, and stakeholder follow\-up to identify related parties, clarify discrepancies, and support ethical risk decisions. Reporting to the Team Manager, you will work with attorneys and business representatives to vet incoming requests, update matter records, and prepare clear reports for review and approval. Your work will protect the firm from conflicts of interest, improve intake quality, and enable teams to pursue new business with confidence. This onsite Gurgaon role requires sound judgment, strong organization, and flexibility for scheduled after\-hours, weekend, and rotational on\-call coverage when business demands require it.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Run timely and accurate conflict searches for preliminary checks, formally submitted new business, new clients, and matters, using database research and Boolean techniques to surface relevant relationships.
* Own daily matter updates by adding new parties, maintaining conflict memos, and ensuring approved client and engagement information remains complete, current, and traceable.
* Vet all requests entering the department, including matter reopenings, new business for existing or new clients, and preliminary checks, resolving missing or inconsistent information before review.
* Evaluate search results and discrepancies methodically, then consolidate findings into clear reports that help attorneys and business stakeholders assess conflicts and manage ethical risk.
* Liaise confidently with attorneys and business representatives by email, telephone, and in person to obtain, clarify, and validate information needed for client and matter intake.
* Prioritize urgent and competing requests in a time\-sensitive environment, maintaining quality, responsiveness, and follow\-through without compromising accuracy or compliance requirements.
* Support the integrity of the conflicts database by applying consistent data standards, documenting updates, and entering general client information after new business approval.
* Participate in scheduled after\-hours or weekend projects and rotational remote on\-call shifts to maintain dependable conflicts support across global teams and deadlines.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Hands\-on experience conducting legal conflict searches, business intake, and conflicts database reviews, with strong attention to detail, accuracy, documentation quality, and ethical risk awareness.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the confidence to engage attorneys and business stakeholders at different levels with clarity, professionalism, and customer\-service orientation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word, plus practical ability to use Boolean search operators and techniques for structured information retrieval.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Prior experience in a law firm, legal department, or professional\-services environment where confidentiality, compliance, and rapid response were essential to daily operations.
* Direct experience with conflicts checking, related\-party research, engagement databases, matter management, or legal business\-intake workflows will help you contribute quickly.
* Familiarity with ABA mandates, conflicts\-of\-interest controls, and ethical risk management is advantageous for evaluating search results and escalating potential concerns appropriately.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Four to six years of experience, including at least three years in a legal, law\-firm, or legal department environment, with conflicts checking or legal intake exposure preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, urgent requests, follow\-ups, and time\-sensitive deadlines while preserving thoroughness, quality, and data integrity.
* A methodical problem\-solving approach that helps you investigate discrepancies, distinguish relevant relationships, and escalate issues with practical recommendations and complete supporting information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, enabling confident interaction with attorneys, business representatives, and colleagues through email, telephone, and in\-person collaboration.
* Strong organization, ownership, and attention to detail, with the judgment to handle confidential information and the discipline to maintain reliable database records.
* A customer\-service mindset and willingness to support scheduled after\-hours or weekend work and rotational on\-call coverage when global business needs require it.
* Proficiency in Outlook, Excel, Word, Boolean search techniques, and structured database research, combined with genuine commitment to compliance and conflicts\-of\-interest controls.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Join a rapidly scaling India capability center that works alongside global case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership, giving legal operations professionals exposure beyond traditional back\-office support.
* Build expertise in conflicts management, ethical risk, and global business intake while collaborating with attorneys and stakeholders across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
* Grow in a meritocratic culture that combines entrepreneurial ownership, continuous learning, on\-the\-job development, and meaningful opportunities to expand your professional capabilities.
* Contribute to a firm where integrity, quality, objectivity, inclusive diversity, and personal reward guide how teams work and how individual impact is recognized.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A structured performance development process, continuous learning, and on\-the\-job training designed to support professional growth and career progression.
* Exposure to global teams, diverse industries, and complex client\-delivery environments within a rapidly growing 1,000\+ member India capability center.
* An entrepreneurial and collaborative culture that values independent thinking, meaningful ownership, inclusion, and practical impact.
* Benefits and well\-being resources that support employees’ professional development and personal journey.

title: Conflicts Analyst
description:
**Who we are**

 Join us to work with colleagues as one global team – empowering each other to be exceptional and create advantage for our clients.
   

  





 Our India team is a well\-established and integral part of the firm’s global operations, delivering high\-value support across a wide spectrum of functions. With over 800 business professionals based in Gurugram and Hyderabad, we’ve been driving operational excellence and innovation for more than 15 years.
   

  





 We contribute to global success in areas such as Information Technology, Finance, Human Resources, Risk \& Compliance, Legal Support, Research \& Knowledge, Document Production, Virtual Executive Assistance, Programme Management, Client \& Market Development, and Continuous Improvement.
   

  

  

  

  

  




**Job Description**


**The role**





 The Clearance Centre is a central part of the firm's risk management function and reports ultimately to the firm's General Counsel.
   

  

  

  






**Who you will work with**





 Working within the Post Clearance Team ("PCT") in CC Delhi, you will be part of a team responsible for the management of conflicts of interest and associated compliance issues across Clifford Chance's global practice, including Europe, the Middle East and Asia. Your primary responsibility will be making decisions on whether new mandates can be accepted or the scope of existing matters amended in the context of current conflicts and regulatory rules, and internal firm policies.
   

  

  

  






**What you will be responsible for**





 The fundamental responsibility of the role is to review requests for clearance to amend existing matters, open supplementary matters and liaise with partners and other fee earners to determine the appropriate ways to do this.
   

  





 In addition, you will undergo extensive ongoing training on:
   

  




* UK conflicts rules and their application in practice;
* Clearance Centre processes and procedures;
* Risk and compliance policies;
* Matter intake workflows




**What you will do**




* Develop comprehensive knowledge of CC conflict policies and their application to real situations as needed.
* Perform initial review of submissions from matter teams and evaluate accuracy and appropriateness of requests.
* Analysing information contained in the Firm's conflict management systems.
* Perform research on various databases to understand the relationship with client and counterparties involved in the new proposal and identify any potential conflicts of interest that may arise.
* Perform research on external databases like Orbis and Merger market to find information about various entities involved in an engagement.
* Assist and analyse for existing mandates whether the updated scope of work is in line with original scope of work cleared on the matter.
* Monitoring mailboxes and responding to the requests of Global and local teams of the firm.
* Facilitate and drive the process to completion by following up on requests from fee earners/secretaries.
* Escalate complex requests to the senior team members.


**Qualifications**


**Your experience**




* Any Graduate, Law degree and legal qualification preferred;
* Minimum 3\-4 yrs of work experience in a corporate/MNC;
* Experience in using Intapp Open or similar tool;
* Experience and ability to work well with others as part of a team and to also work independently;
* Some experience of working in a commercial environment (legal or otherwise) would be very useful, but not essential;
* Analytical skills and a proven ability to solve problems in a methodical and practical way;
* Ability to gather and analyse information and to use the results of that analysis to make effective decisions and find innovative solutions to problems;
* Excellent communication skills;
* Attention to detail;
* Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple demands on your time simultaneously;
* A quick learner able to adapt to new processes and technology;
* Good interpersonal skills and an ability to form working relationships with others, both inside and outside of the Clearance Centre.


**Additional Information**


**How we will support you**





 From your first day with us, you will have varied opportunities to continuously grow and development your skills and knowledge. From formal training, informal coaching and mentoring through to skills\-based and technical training and on the job learning.
   

  

  

  






**Equal opportunities**





 At Clifford Chance, we forge an inclusive culture, where diverse perspectives are recognised and valued. It’s a culture where everyone has equal access to opportunities to thrive and succeed. We are guided by our values\-based Code, which sets high standards of conduct and has a principle focused on being inclusive.
   

  





 We comply with the law and regulations in every location where we operate and we are committed to delivering fair and equal access to all applicants and employees irrespective of background. This applies across all aspects of employment from recruitment and selection to development, progression, and day\-to\-day working life.
   

  





 Our global network of affinity, faith and support groups are open to all. These communities help to create an environment where everyone at the firm can feel they belong and can reach their full potential.
   

  





 Find out more about our inclusive culture here.

* Support investigation, triaging, escalation, and resolution of potentially suspect claims.
* Collaborate with scheme authorities, healthcare providers, analytics teams, technology teams, and other stakeholders to support fraud control initiatives.
* Deliver technical orientation and capacity\-building support for claims adjudicators and relevant program personnel.

* Essential: MBBS from a recognized Indian university/institution (FMGs will not be considered)
* Desirable: MD or Postgraduate Medical Qualification from a recognized university/institution.


**Experience**
* Experience Requirements Candidates across the following experience bands are required: o 3 to 6 years of experience. o Experience in medical audits, claims review, utilization review, healthcare fraud management, health insurance, or government healthcare schemes preferred.
